audit_metadata.title: Independent Validation Results and Accounting Audit
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Independent Quantitative Research Auditor & Financial-Accounting Verification Engineer
audit_metadata.executive_verdict: PASS WITH LIMITATIONS — NO CANDIDATE QUALIFIED; NON-MATERIAL ISSUES REMAIN

findings.expected_behavior: Starting Capital + Net P&L in trade ledger equals Ending Equity in portfolio ledger.
findings.observed_behavior: Ending Equity is Rs. 783.13 to Rs. 2,234.85 higher than Starting Capital + Trade Ledger Net P&L.
findings.numerical_evidence: For CFG-01: Discrepancy = Rs. 2,056.23; calculated terminal sell friction on 10 open positions = Rs. 2,056.20 (Residual = Rs. 0.03). For CFG-BASE: Discrepancy = Rs. 2,234.85; calculated terminal sell friction on 10 open positions = Rs. 2,234.74 (Residual = Rs. 0.11). For CFG-16: Discrepancy = Rs. 1,258.45; calculated terminal sell friction on 6 open positions = Rs. 1,258.43 (Residual = Rs. 0.02).
findings.root_cause: The portfolio ledger records gross mark-to-market equity at session Close on date T (portfolio_equity = cash + sum(qty * Close)), whereas the synthetic trade ledger liquidation at the end of the backtest deducts hypothetical terminal sell friction (statutory exit taxes, exchange fees, brokerage, and exit slippage). The numerical bridge is exact down to two-decimal rounding.
findings.required_remediation: None. Documented institutional NAV mark-to-market reporting convention.

findings.expected_behavior: Strategy and benchmark returns measured on perfectly symmetric friction conventions.
findings.observed_behavior: Benchmark models frictionless gross buy-and-hold (+59.22%), while strategy models full delivery friction and 5 bps slippage.
findings.numerical_evidence: Strategy candidates achieved cumulative net returns of +10.81% to +24.50%. Passive buy-and-hold achieved +59.22%. The performance deficit is 34.72 to 48.41 percentage points. Subtracting standard delivery friction (~0.25% one-time) from the benchmark leaves +58.85%, still far exceeding all candidates.
findings.root_cause: The baseline engine calculates passive benchmark return from raw Close price ratios without trade friction simulation.
findings.required_remediation: None for validation rejection; record as methodology limitation for future research stages.

findings.expected_behavior: Strategy with Sharpe > Hurdle is statistically evaluated for sampling variance under multiple testing.
findings.observed_behavior: CFG-16 achieved Sharpe 1.0283 > Hurdle 0.9698 (+0.0585 surplus), but DSR p-value was 0.4631 (non-significant).
findings.numerical_evidence: Mertens variance V = 0.7662 with skewness gamma_3 = 4.19 and kurtosis gamma_4 = 36.88. Over T = 486 sessions, z-score is only 0.0927, yielding DSR = 0.5369 and p = 0.4631.
findings.root_cause: Excess return kurtosis and sample size widen the standard error of the Sharpe ratio; a marginal surplus (+0.0585) is insufficient to reject the null hypothesis of selection bias.
findings.required_remediation: None. Protocol correctly classified CFG-16 as non-significant.

benchmark_audit.name: NIFTY 50 Equal-Weight Buy & Hold
benchmark_audit.comparability_assessment: NON-MATERIAL LIMITATION: The benchmark is computed as a gross, frictionless buy-and-hold allocation without statutory delivery costs or execution slippage. In contrast, candidate strategies bear full statutory delivery friction (~0.25% per round trip), 5 bps slippage per leg, and cash drag from 10-position limits. However, the performance gap between the benchmark (+59.22%) and the best candidate (+24.50%) is 34.72 percentage points; deducting ~0.25% delivery friction from the benchmark would yield +58.85%, which still vastly exceeds all candidate strategies. Therefore, this difference in return convention does not alter any candidate rejection.

statistical_audit.statistical_reproducibility: EXACT (Matches to double precision IEEE 754 across all metrics)

conclusion.verdict: PASS WITH LIMITATIONS — NO CANDIDATE QUALIFIED; NON-MATERIAL ISSUES REMAIN
conclusion.research_recommendation: The Sprint 6.2 conclusion ('NO CANDIDATE PASSED ALL PREREGISTERED CRITERIA') is fully substantiated and audited. Zero candidate configurations may be frozen or deployed. The validation dataset has been exposed to candidate selection and cannot be treated as a fresh untouched holdout. Future research must focus on fundamental signal enhancement, feature engineering, and regime filtering before re-approaching holdouts.
